title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. (Fatawa Rizvia, Part 3, Page 622) Can you please advise if the above method can be followed sagely 2925 views Q. Dear Muftisab, My friend is a namaazi but he drinks beer sometimes. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 2065 Country: India Title: I study in Mumbai. Three day back I went to Gujarat (302 km away from Mumbai) for interview. I came back yesterday and I have to go to Gujarat once more for second interview after 3 days (between these two journeys I determined to stay here in Mumbai for 6 days obnly). In this case should I perform 2-4 or 4-4? I did imamat as well in these days in 4 Rakahs of Zuhr; Do my followers in the Zuhr need to perform it again? I also don?t remember which day I lead them in Zuhr. Am I Musafir while staying in Mumbai in this period? Please reply in detail. Question: I study in Mumbai. Three day back I went to Gujarat (302 km away from Mumbai) for interview. I came back yesterday and I have to go to Gujarat once more for second interview after 3 days (between these two journeys I determined to stay here in Mumbai for 6 days obnly). In this case should I perform 2-4 or 4-4? I did imamat as well in these days in 4 Rakahs of Zuhr; Do my followers in the Zuhr need to perform it again? I also don?t remember which day I lead them in Zuhr. Am I Musafir while staying in Mumbai in this period? Please reply in detail. Answer ID: 2065 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1425/1255=B) If Mumbai is not your native place, but you only stay there then you have to pray two rakat instead of the four- rakat obligatory salah. (2) Yes, the salah of muqeem muqtadis (those who followed the imam and were not musafir ) will be invalid. It is wajib (necessary) for you to announce it so that muqtadis of the Zuhr Salah repeat their salah . Though you do not remember the date and day, but then also you should announce it so that they make up with the intention of that day. (3) Yes, you will remain musafir , watan-e-iqamat (the place you stay and which is not your native place) comes to an end by journey; so when you will return there with the intention of staying 15 days or more then you will be muqeem . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
